newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Solartech International sets 125 mln shr IPO.
newsitem.headline: HK's Solartech International sets 125 mln shr IPO.

text.p: Cable maker and exporter Solartech International Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it is issuing 125 million new shares at HK$1.20 each in an initial public offering in Hong Kong.
The new issue, which represents 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital, would be offered for public subscription from December 2 to 5, it said in a statement.
Dealings in the company's shares on the Hong Kong stock exchange are expected to begin on December 12, it added.

The sponsor and manager of the share offer is Lippo Securities Ltd. The underwriting syndicate are Lippo Securities Ltd, China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong) Ltd, Okasan International (Asia) Ltd, Tai Fook Securities Co Ltd, United IBV Ltd, Crosby Investment Services (Hong Kong) Ltd, Amsteel Securities (Hong Kong) Ltd and NSC Securities (Asia) Ltd, it said.
